paper_metadata.title: Laser Brazing of a Nickel-based Superalloy using a Ni-Mn-Fe-Co-Cu High Entropy Alloy Filler Metal

evidence.quote: laser brazed Inconel® 718 using a Ni-Mn-Fe-Co-Cu high entropy alloy filler metal with a nominal Ni:Cu:Co:Fe:Mn molar ratio of 1:1:1:0.25:1.75

The HEA filler metal is cold-rolled to a ~0.4 mm thick piece and placed between two Inconel® pieces coated with 601B flux in a lap joint configuration with a 1.5 mm overlap.
Lap joints were brazed by combining two diode lasers (wavelength = 806 nm), one 500 W laser (focal length = 20 cm) and one 400 W laser (focal length = 10 cm).
